full_judgment: 2. The Opposite party nos. 1 to 13 filed a suit against the defendant petitioners and opposite party nos. 14 to 26 being Title suit no. 204 of 1988 in the Court of the Assistant Judge, Sadar, Laxmipur, praying for a decree for declaraion of title in the suit land. The petitioners as defendant nos. 1 to 3 contested the suit by filing a writting statement contending inter alia. that the original owner of the suit land was Hara Mohan Charkavarty which housed his kachary and also a bazar, as such, the land in question vested in the Government under the provisions of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950 and the Tahshil Office and bazars are situated there that the plaintiffs have got not right  title or possession in the suit land After hearing the Trail Court decreed the suit which was also affirmed in appeal being Title Appeal No. 112 to 1996 Being aggrieved, the petitioners filed the instant revisional application along with an application under Section 5 of the, Limitation act, praying condo-nation of delay o 510 days in filing the revisional application. On hearing the said petition the instant rule on delay was issued on 20.11.2000.
